caption:
Who Allah is with, in one short verse

Allah says He is with those who fear Him and those who do good. Carry both into your Saturday: awareness of Him, and one good deed for someone.

Surah An-Nahl 16:128

Name one good deed you will do before noon.

#allahiswithyou #taqwa #ihsan #surahnahl

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
